prompt: Write a YARA rule that detects an Emotet loader binary identified by its mutex name 'Global\\I98B68E3C', the embedded SmokeLoader-style RC4 key 'EmotetLoader2024', and the magic 4D 5A (PE) at offset 0.
artifact:
rule Emotet_Loader_2024 {
    meta:
        author = "GhostLM"
        description = "Detects Emotet loader via mutex name and RC4 key"
        family = "emotet"
        tlp = "AMBER"
        date = "2026-05-08"
    strings:
        $h_pe = { 4D 5A }
        $s_mutex = "Global\\I98B68E3C" wide ascii
        $s_rc4key = "EmotetLoader2024" wide ascii
        $hex_xor = { 81 ?? ?? ?? ?? 33 C0 89 }
    condition:
        $h_pe at 0 and 2 of ($s_*) and any of ($hex_*)
}

prompt: Write a YARA rule for a phishing JavaScript dropper. The script base64-decodes a payload, calls 'eval(atob(', and references a domain ending in 'login-portal.invalid'. File magic is plain text (no PE).
artifact:
rule Phishing_JS_Dropper {
    meta:
        author = "GhostLM"
        description = "JavaScript dropper that eval-decodes a base64 payload"
        family = "js_dropper"
        tlp = "GREEN"
        date = "2026-05-08"
    strings:
        $s_eval = "eval(atob(" ascii
        $s_atob = "atob" ascii
        $s_lure = "login-portal.invalid" ascii nocase
        $hex_b64 = { 65 76 61 6C 28 61 74 6F 62 28 }
    condition:
        not uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and 2 of ($s_*) and #s_atob >= 1
}

prompt: Write a Sigma rule for ATT&CK T1059.001 detecting suspicious PowerShell command execution with encoded commands (-EncodedCommand or -enc) AND base64 payload longer than 100 chars in the command line, on Windows process creation events.
artifact:
title: Suspicious PowerShell Encoded Command Execution
id: 6f0ad1a6-3e09-4b3e-9f0a-d1a63e094b3e
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell processes spawned with -EncodedCommand / -enc plus a long base64 payload, characteristic of T1059.001 obfuscation
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/
author: GhostLM
date: 2026/05/08
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_image:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\\powershell.exe'
            - '\\pwsh.exe'
    selection_flag:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '-EncodedCommand'
            - '-enc '
    selection_payload:
        CommandLine|re: '[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{100,}'
    condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate admin scripts using -EncodedCommand for quoting safety
level: high
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001

prompt: Write a Sigma rule for ATT&CK T1133 detecting external RDP login from an unusual geo, on Windows authentication logs. Logsource: windows / security. Trigger when EventID 4624, LogonType 10, and IpAddress is from an external (non-RFC1918) range.
artifact:
title: External RDP Logon From Public Address
id: 8e3c52a7-5b1f-4e2c-a83c-52a75b1f4e2c
status: experimental
description: Detects successful RDP logon (LogonType=10) where the source IP is a public/external address, suggesting external RDP exposure (T1133)
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1133/
author: GhostLM
date: 2026/05/08
logsource:
    product: windows
    service: security
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 4624
        LogonType: 10
    filter_internal:
        IpAddress|startswith:
            - '10.'
            - '192.168.'
            - '172.16.'
            - '172.17.'
            - '172.18.'
            - '172.19.'
            - '172.20.'
            - '127.'
    condition: selection and not filter_internal
falsepositives:
    - Authorized remote work over RDP via public IPs
    - VPN concentrators that NAT to public IPs
level: medium
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.t1133
